meta_description: Tantech Electricals provides expert electrical services in Birmingham. Fully qualified electrician offering installations, repairs and maintenance. Call 07386 775618.
hero_eyebrow: Qualified Electrician — Local, Reliable, Fair Prices
hero_subhead: Faulty electrics or urgent repairs? We're based in Shaftmoor and respond quickly to keep your home safe and running.
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to planned installations, we handle all domestic and small commercial electrical work.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, tripped circuits, faulty switches — we diagnose and fix the problem fast. Available 24/7 for genuine emergencies in Birmingham.

services.title: Boiler & Heating Electrics
services.desc: Electrical faults affecting your central heating or hot water? We trace the issue, repair wiring and controls, and get your system running safely again.

services.title: Rewiring & Upgrades
services.desc: Old wiring, outdated fusebox or too few sockets? We plan and install modern circuits to meet building regulations, improving safety and capacity.

services.title: Consumer Unit Installation
services.desc: Upgrade your fuse board to a modern consumer unit. Safer, more reliable, and essential if you're adding new circuits or appliances.

services.title: Socket & Light Installation
services.desc: New sockets, USB points and lighting to suit your home layout. We handle all the wiring neatly and test everything for safety.

services.title: Fault Finding & Testing
services.desc: Can't find the source of an electrical fault? We use diagnostic equipment to pinpoint the problem, then quote you a fair repair price.

about_pullquote: I started Tantech to give Birmingham homes an honest, reliable electrician.
about_para_1: Tantech Electricals was founded on a simple principle: turn up on time, fix the problem right, and charge a fair price. With over 15 years' experience installing and repairing electrics across Birmingham, we've built our reputation one satisfied customer at a time. Based on Shaftmoor Lane, we know the area inside out and respond quickly to both emergencies and planned work.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we're straightforward. We explain what's wrong, show you the options, and never push unnecessary work. Whether it's a faulty socket, a full rewire, or a midnight emergency, we treat your home with the same care we'd give our own. Many of our jobs come from word-of-mouth recommendation — a testament to the service we deliver.

reviews.text: Our kitchen lights kept flickering and I was worried it was something serious. Called Tantech and Mark came out the next morning. Diagnosed a loose connection in the consumer unit in about 20 minutes, fixed it properly and explained what had happened. Fair price, no messing about. Would use again for sure.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Needed a full rewire in our 1960s semi. Got two other quotes but Tantech's price was competitive and the team was professional throughout. Took three days, left the house clean, and everything was tested and certified. Brilliant job and they made a real effort to minimise disruption.
reviews.author: Janet M.

reviews.text: Emergency call at 10pm because our boiler electrics had failed and it was freezing. Tantech answered, came within the hour and got us heating again. Charged a fair rate for the call-out too. Proper, helpful bloke. Cheers.
reviews.author: Chris T.
